datasets.name: portfolio_summary
queryLines: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.symbol) AS total_holdings, ROUND(SUM(p.shares_held * f.current_eps), 2)  AS total_current_earnings, ROUND(SUM(p.shares_held * e.forward_eps), 2)  AS total_projected_earnings, SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_income < 0 OR f.debt_to_equity_ratio > 2.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_stocks FROM ( SELECT symbol, UPPER(symbol) AS ticker_region, number_of_shares AS shares_held FROM mp_portfolio_federated.dbo.equity_holdings WHERE instrument_type = 'Equity' ) p JOIN ( SELECT a.ticker_region, c.FF_NET_INCOME AS net_income, c.FF_EPS_BASIC AS current_eps, ROUND(c.FF_NET_INCOME / NULLIF(c.FF_SALES, 0) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct, ROUND((c.FF_DEBT_ST + c.FF_DEBT_LT) / NULLIF(c.FF_COM_EQ, 0), 2) AS debt_to_equity_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ticker_region ORDER BY c.DATE DESC) AS rn FROM mp_factset_data.sym_v1.sym_ticker_region a JOIN mp_factset_data.ff_v3.ff_sec_map b ON a.fsym_id = b.fsym_id JOIN mp_factset_data.ff_v3.ff_basic_af c ON b.fsym_company_id = c.fsym_id WHERE c.DATE >= '2023-01-01' AND c.FF_EPS_BASIC IS NOT NULL AND ABS(c.FF_EPS_BASIC) < 50 AND c.FF_SALES > 0 ) f ON p.ticker_region = f.ticker_region AND f.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.ticker_region, c.FE_MEAN AS forward_eps, c.FE_NUM_EST AS analyst_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ticker_region ORDER BY c.FE_FP_END) AS rn FROM mp_factset_data.sym_v1.sym_ticker_region a JOIN mp_factset_data.fe_v4.fe_sec_map b ON a.fsym_id = b.fsym_id JOIN mp_factset_data.fe_v4.fe_basic_conh_af c ON b.fsym_company_id = c.fsym_id WHERE c.FE_ITEM = 'EPS' AND c.CONS_END_DATE IS NULL AND c.FE_FP_END >= CURRENT_DATE() AND ABS(c.FE_MEAN) < 50 ) e ON p.ticker_region = e.ticker_region AND e.rn = 1

datasets.name: risk_distribution
queryLines: SELECT CASE WHEN f.net_income < 0 OR f.debt_to_equity_ratio > 2.5 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN ((e.forward_eps - f.current_eps) / NULLIF(f.current_eps, 0)) < -0.15 OR f.profit_margin_pct < 3 THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END AS risk_category, COUNT(*) AS num_stocks, ROUND(SUM(p.shares_held * f.current_eps), 2) AS total_earnings FROM ( SELECT symbol, UPPER(symbol) AS ticker_region, number_of_shares AS shares_held FROM mp_portfolio_federated.dbo.equity_holdings WHERE instrument_type = 'Equity' ) p JOIN ( SELECT a.ticker_region, c.FF_NET_INCOME AS net_income, c.FF_EPS_BASIC AS current_eps, ROUND(c.FF_NET_INCOME / NULLIF(c.FF_SALES, 0) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct, ROUND((c.FF_DEBT_ST + c.FF_DEBT_LT) / NULLIF(c.FF_COM_EQ, 0), 2) AS debt_to_equity_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ticker_region ORDER BY c.DATE DESC) AS rn FROM mp_factset_data.sym_v1.sym_ticker_region a JOIN mp_factset_data.ff_v3.ff_sec_map b ON a.fsym_id = b.fsym_id JOIN mp_factset_data.ff_v3.ff_basic_af c ON b.fsym_company_id = c.fsym_id WHERE c.DATE >= '2023-01-01' AND c.FF_EPS_BASIC IS NOT NULL AND ABS(c.FF_EPS_BASIC) < 50 AND c.FF_SALES > 0 ) f ON p.ticker_region = f.ticker_region AND f.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.ticker_region, c.FE_MEAN AS forward_eps, c.FE_NUM_EST AS analyst_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ticker_region ORDER BY c.FE_FP_END) AS rn FROM mp_factset_data.sym_v1.sym_ticker_region a JOIN mp_factset_data.fe_v4.fe_sec_map b ON a.fsym_id = b.fsym_id JOIN mp_factset_data.fe_v4.fe_basic_conh_af c ON b.fsym_company_id = c.fsym_id WHERE c.FE_ITEM = 'EPS' AND c.CONS_END_DATE IS NULL AND c.FE_FP_END >= CURRENT_DATE() AND ABS(c.FE_MEAN) < 50 ) e ON p.ticker_region = e.ticker_region AND e.rn = 1 GROUP BY risk_category ORDER BY CASE risk_category WHEN 'High Risk' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium Risk' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

datasets.name: action_distribution
queryLines: SELECT CASE WHEN f.net_income < 0 THEN 'Sell' WHEN ((e.forward_eps - f.current_eps) / NULLIF(f.current_eps, 0)) < -0.15 THEN 'Sell' WHEN ((e.forward_eps - f.current_eps) / NULLIF(f.current_eps, 0)) > 0.20 THEN 'Strong Buy' WHEN ((e.forward_eps - f.current_eps) / NULLIF(f.current_eps, 0)) > 0.05 THEN 'Buy' ELSE 'Hold' END AS recommendation, COUNT(*) AS num_stocks FROM ( SELECT symbol, UPPER(symbol) AS ticker_region, number_of_shares AS shares_held FROM mp_portfolio_federated.dbo.equity_holdings WHERE instrument_type = 'Equity' ) p JOIN ( SELECT a.ticker_region, c.FF_NET_INCOME AS net_income, c.FF_EPS_BASIC AS current_eps, ROUND(c.FF_NET_INCOME / NULLIF(c.FF_SALES, 0) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct, ROUND((c.FF_DEBT_ST + c.FF_DEBT_LT) / NULLIF(c.FF_COM_EQ, 0), 2) AS debt_to_equity_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ticker_region ORDER BY c.DATE DESC) AS rn FROM mp_factset_data.sym_v1.sym_ticker_region a JOIN mp_factset_data.ff_v3.ff_sec_map b ON a.fsym_id = b.fsym_id JOIN mp_factset_data.ff_v3.ff_basic_af c ON b.fsym_company_id = c.fsym_id WHERE c.DATE >= '2023-01-01' AND c.FF_EPS_BASIC IS NOT NULL AND ABS(c.FF_EPS_BASIC) < 50 AND c.FF_SALES > 0 ) f ON p.ticker_region = f.ticker_region AND f.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.ticker_region, c.FE_MEAN AS forward_eps, c.FE_NUM_EST AS analyst_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ticker_region ORDER BY c.FE_FP_END) AS rn FROM mp_factset_data.sym_v1.sym_ticker_region a JOIN mp_factset_data.fe_v4.fe_sec_map b ON a.fsym_id = b.fsym_id JOIN mp_factset_data.fe_v4.fe_basic_conh_af c ON b.fsym_company_id = c.fsym_id WHERE c.FE_ITEM = 'EPS' AND c.CONS_END_DATE IS NULL AND c.FE_FP_END >= CURRENT_DATE() AND ABS(c.FE_MEAN) < 50 ) e ON p.ticker_region = e.ticker_region AND e.rn = 1 GROUP BY recommendation ORDER BY CASE recommendation WHEN 'Sell' THEN 1 WHEN 'Hold' THEN 2 WHEN 'Buy' THEN 3 WHEN 'Strong Buy' THEN 4 END

datasets.name: top_earnings
queryLines: SELECT p.symbol, ROUND(p.shares_held * f.current_eps, 2) AS current_earnings, ROUND(p.shares_held * e.forward_eps, 2) AS projected_earnings FROM ( SELECT symbol, UPPER(symbol) AS ticker_region, number_of_shares AS shares_held FROM mp_portfolio_federated.dbo.equity_holdings WHERE instrument_type = 'Equity' ) p JOIN ( SELECT a.ticker_region, c.FF_NET_INCOME AS net_income, c.FF_EPS_BASIC AS current_eps, ROUND(c.FF_NET_INCOME / NULLIF(c.FF_SALES, 0) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct, ROUND((c.FF_DEBT_ST + c.FF_DEBT_LT) / NULLIF(c.FF_COM_EQ, 0), 2) AS debt_to_equity_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ticker_region ORDER BY c.DATE DESC) AS rn FROM mp_factset_data.sym_v1.sym_ticker_region a JOIN mp_factset_data.ff_v3.ff_sec_map b ON a.fsym_id = b.fsym_id JOIN mp_factset_data.ff_v3.ff_basic_af c ON b.fsym_company_id = c.fsym_id WHERE c.DATE >= '2023-01-01' AND c.FF_EPS_BASIC IS NOT NULL AND ABS(c.FF_EPS_BASIC) < 50 AND c.FF_SALES > 0 ) f ON p.ticker_region = f.ticker_region AND f.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.ticker_region, c.FE_MEAN AS forward_eps, c.FE_NUM_EST AS analyst_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ticker_region ORDER BY c.FE_FP_END) AS rn FROM mp_factset_data.sym_v1.sym_ticker_region a JOIN mp_factset_data.fe_v4.fe_sec_map b ON a.fsym_id = b.fsym_id JOIN mp_factset_data.fe_v4.fe_basic_conh_af c ON b.fsym_company_id = c.fsym_id WHERE c.FE_ITEM = 'EPS' AND c.CONS_END_DATE IS NULL AND c.FE_FP_END >= CURRENT_DATE() AND ABS(c.FE_MEAN) < 50 ) e ON p.ticker_region = e.ticker_region AND e.rn = 1 WHERE p.shares_held * f.current_eps IS NOT NULL ORDER BY current_earnings DESC LIMIT 10
